This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="The Platform Classic" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|blue-gray]] and black skin, as well as tufts of [[Hair|fur]] of the same blue-gray color. They possessed large builds, with a number of [[Bone|horns]] on their heads, including two curved ones extending from behind their [[Mouth|jaw]], one sticking straight up from the top of their heads, two large, gangly black horns protruding from the back of their craniums, and an assortment of other smaller black cranial spikes as well. The species had large chins, with pronounced underbites, pointed [[Tooth|teeth]], yellow [[Eye|eyes]], and long, pointed [[Ear|ears]] that stuck out from the sides of their heads.<ref name="The Platform Classic" />

==Species in the galaxy==
One member of this species was a resident aboard the [[supertanker fuel depot]] known as the ''[[Colossus]]''<ref name="The Platform Classic" /> by [[34 ABY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' establishes that the events of [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|''Star Wars Resistance'' Season One]], which includes the episode "[[The Platform Classic]]", takes place in [[34 ABY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in the [[The Platform Classic|ninth episode]] of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'' animated television series,<ref name="The Platform Classic" /> aired on [[November 25]], [[2018]].<ref name="Air date">{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}}</ref>
